page_title: AUG 2-2 BOC | Augsburg v Bochum 02/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) commits a foul and Martin Petersen immediately signals a free kick.

90+4' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) wastes an opportunity! He unleashed a strong shot from distance after the rebound fell at his feet. It went in the direction of the left post, but the goalkeeper pulled off a nice save to deny him.
90+4' The ball is out of play. Augsburg will have a throw-in.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Thomas Letsch prepares a substitution. Bernardo is replaced by Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum).
87' Substitution. Arne Maier (Augsburg) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Dion Beljo walks off.
87' Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) picks up an injury.
86' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
85' Great teamplay by Bochum as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
83' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) takes the mid-range free kick and sends it towards the roof of the net, but he is denied by the goalkeeper.
81' Substitution. Takuma Asano leaves the pitch and is replaced by Moritz Broschinski (Bochum).
81' Thomas Letsch has decided to make a change. Lukas Daschner (Bochum) replaces Matus Bero.
81' Corner kick. Augsburg will have an opportunity.

80' What a great chance for Robert Gumny (Augsburg). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header right under the bar, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
80' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Augsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
78' It will be a substitution. Robert Gumny (Augsburg) is ready to enter the pitch as Arne Engels walks off.
78' Enrico Maassen has decided to substitute Elvis Rexhbecaj and he is replaced by Tim Breithaupt (Augsburg).
78' Ruben Vargas comes off the pitch to be replaced by Irvin Cardona (Augsburg).
76' Bochum failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
75' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. Bochum have a corner.
71' Thomas Letsch has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) replacing Philipp Hofmann.
70' The ball is out of play. Bochum will have a chance to score from a corner.
66' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Phillip Tietz.
66' Referee Martin Petersen signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Bochum players have a reason to celebrate!
66' The goal for Bochum is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.

64' 2 - 2 What a wonderful finish! Takuma Asano (Bochum) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and drills a low shot into the bottom right corner. There are not enough superlatives to describe that goal.
62' 2 - 1 Goal! Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:2.
60' The referee blows his whistle, Bochum are awarded a corner kick.
57' Matus Bero (Bochum) commits a rough challenge and Martin Petersen blows his whistle for an infringement.
57' Flag up against Matus Bero (Bochum). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
57' Rough tackle by Kevin Stoger (Bochum). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
55' Neat passing move from Bochum in order to create new attacking opportunities.
52' Dion Beljo (Augsburg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Manuel Riemann, who smothers the ball.
48' Felix Passlack (Bochum) sees a yellow card from Martin Petersen after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
46' Matus Bero (Bochum) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Martin Petersen didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' 1 - 1 Goal! Takuma Asano (Bochum) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top right corner. It's 1:1.
45+3' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) gets into a shooting position! What a long-range cannonball of a shot! His nice effort, however, only crashes against the left post. Aim better, sir.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg).
43' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Finn Dahmen.
42' Martin Petersen has a clear sight and sees a foul from Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg).
41' Bochum fail to score from a corner as Finn Dahmen (Augsburg) leaps to collect the ball.
41' Takuma Asano (Bochum) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee signals a corner kick to Bochum.
40' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Augsburg comes to nothing.
38' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) blazes a shot from a long-range free kick and the ball ends somewhere in row Z.
38' Martin Petersen shows a yellow card to Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) for a tough tackle.
35' 1 - 0 Dion Beljo (Augsburg) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
34' Augsburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
31' Dion Beljo (Augsburg) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
30' Matus Bero (Bochum) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. Finn Dahmen is alert and denies him with a nice save.
27' Martin Petersen blows for a foul after Kevin Stoger (Bochum) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
24' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Dion Beljo (Augsburg) heads on.
23' Takuma Asano (Bochum) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
21' Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
21' Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
20' Bochum players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
19' Ivan Ordets (Bochum) is able to continue to play.
17' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) cracks a splendid volley from just outside the box that brushes the left post. It was an incredible shot and the goalkeeper was really lucky not to concede a goal.
17' Looks like Ivan Ordets (Bochum) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
16' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) commits a foul during an attacking move.
12' A player from Augsburg commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
11' The referee blows his whistle as Matus Bero (Bochum) was too aggressive in his challenge.
8' Ivan Ordets (Bochum) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Martin Petersen saw the whole situation.
7' Takuma Asano (Bochum) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
5' The Bochum players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
4' Takuma Asano (Bochum) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.

3' Takuma Asano (Bochum) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Finn Dahmen to get hold of the ball.
1' The ball is behind the sideline. Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) takes a throw-in.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Augsburg will take the kick-off.
Martin Petersen is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
